About Me

I'm Iniya, a UI/UX Designer with a passion for turning ideas into meaningful digital experiences.

With a background in Business Administration and hands-on experience in enterprise and service-based products, I focus on understanding complex problems and transforming them into structured, easy-to-use digital experiences.

My work includes CRM/ERP/HRMS dashboards, school management systems, hospital workflows, business networking platforms, and service-based websites.
